capabilities: Open the native terminal at the vault root from a ribbon icon
Open the terminal at any folder or file via the file explorer context menu
Auto-detect the system default terminal on Linux and fall back to known emulators
Select a preferred terminal (Ghostty, Kitty, Ptyxis) via Style Settings
Hide the ribbon button when only the context menu is wanted
extras: macOS support is untested (automated tests only); Obsidian's automated review reports one shell-execution capability warning, which the README explains in detail.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a terminal in the current vault or folder, so users must open a terminal manually and cd to the directory.

relations.evidence: If you use the Style Settings plugin, you can easily customize

summary: Terminal launcher that opens the operating system's native terminal at the vault root or at any folder or file via ribbon icon or context menu.
